tooltip.civitatum_starclock.use: Look up and hold Use beneath a clear night sky.
message.civitatum_starclock.cooldown: The sky is silent. Next ritual in %s game days.
message.civitatum_starclock.busy: A ritual is already underway in this world.
message.civitatum_starclock.unavailable: You cannot begin a ritual now.
message.civitatum_starclock.dimension: The ritual requires the Overworld sky.
message.civitatum_starclock.sky: Find an open view of the sky.
sign.civitatum_starclock.serpent.any: The Serpent is whole. A blessing or a curse.
omen.civitatum_starclock.spear_upright: The Spear stands upright. Help in battle comes clad in iron.
omen.civitatum_starclock.smith_upright: The Smith stands upright. What is broken will be whole again.
omen.civitatum_starclock.messenger_uprig: The Messenger stands upright. The road opens; the message arrives before you.
omen.civitatum_starclock.shepherd_uprigh: The Shepherd stands upright. This night you are guarded.
omen.civitatum_starclock.ancestor_uprigh: The Ancestor stands upright. The dead draw back; old debts return.
omen.civitatum_starclock.mother_upright: The Mother stands upright. Hunger recedes; the earth provides.
omen.civitatum_starclock.spinner_upright: The Spinner stands upright. The person you need will find you.
omen.civitatum_starclock.wanderer_uprigh: The Wanderer stands upright. A door opens where you stand.
omen.civitatum_starclock.hearth_upright: The Hearth stands upright. Fire brings warmth without burning.
omen.civitatum_starclock.tower_upright: The Tower stands upright. Protection stands between you and the blow.
omen.civitatum_starclock.merchant_uprigh: The Merchant stands upright. The price will be fair.
omen.civitatum_starclock.beast_upright: The Beast stands upright. The pack answers your call.
omen.civitatum_starclock.spear_reversed: The Spear is reversed. The blow comes from where you least expect.
omen.civitatum_starclock.smith_reversed: The Smith is reversed. What you hold will fail.
omen.civitatum_starclock.messenger_rever: The Messenger is reversed. The message is late; the road is closed.
omen.civitatum_starclock.shepherd_revers: The Shepherd is reversed. Night comes without a watch.
omen.civitatum_starclock.ancestor_revers: The Ancestor is reversed. The dead remember the way back.
omen.civitatum_starclock.mother_reversed: The Mother is reversed. The earth withholds; hunger comes.
omen.civitatum_starclock.spinner_reverse: The Spinner is reversed. The thread breaks; you stand alone.
omen.civitatum_starclock.wanderer_revers: The Wanderer is reversed. The door closes behind you.
omen.civitatum_starclock.hearth_reversed: The Hearth is reversed. Fire takes its due.
omen.civitatum_starclock.tower_reversed: The Tower is reversed. Your support gives way.
omen.civitatum_starclock.merchant_revers: The Merchant is reversed. Everything has its price.
omen.civitatum_starclock.beast_reversed: The Beast is reversed. The pack comes against you.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_1: The Serpent is whole. Poison passes you by.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_2: The Serpent is whole. Poison finds your enemy.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_3: The Serpent is whole. You will hold firm.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_4: The Serpent is whole. Shed your skin.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_5: The Serpent is whole. Poison stays within you.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_6: The Serpent is whole. The bite comes from within.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_7: The Serpent is whole. You bite yourself.
omen.civitatum_starclock.serpent_8: The Serpent is whole. The circle stays closed.
ability.civitatum_starclock.tower_key.de: Opens the closed iron door or trapdoor you are looking at within 5 blocks.
ability.civitatum_starclock.tower_key.no: Look at a closed iron door or trapdoor within five blocks.
message.civitatum_starclock.configuratio: Starclock settings are invalid. Contact the administrator.
